name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and the ongoing conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to stimulate further conversation or interest from the other participant.

name: Informational Value
description: Evaluates the inclusion of interesting facts or new information that adds value to the conversation.

name: Clarity and Coherence
description: Examines how clear and logically structured the response is, making it easy to understand.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly how it contributes uniquely to the conversation.
